Very close behind him tread the Hamilton twins, Robert and John, with Alan Chandler also near to the fore. Apart from these,our usual scoring four, there are several other youngsters ready to pounce should the present leaders falter.
At the finish Ray Young was 6th, having lost two places in the run in, Alan Chandler with a final effort gained a few places to finish 28th, Trevor Upham was 46th and John Hamilton 60th.
Young--who salvaged the situation to gain us a close 5th position. John Hamilton got the better of his brother Bob for the first time in three races; the margin?---one second!

John Hamilton ran a good 440y, being well up for half a lap. He had taken too much out of himself, however, and was just pipped in the straight by a very strong Hercules boy who had taken his first furlong somewhat easier.

Youths 4 x 110yds - Composed of three Tulse Hill school mates and John Hamilton, the Youth team looked promising. It is obvious that with a little extra training, John, Eric Wickens, Geoff Shaw and Steve White will end up with performances equalling those of last years Junior team.
Tony also won the 'quarter' and 'half' in good times with Philip 2nd again and John Hamilton, only a first year Youth, putting up a great performance for 3rd place in the shorter event.
LEFT TO RIGHT: Robert Poole,Victor Butcher,Robert Williams,Geoffrey Rosam, Richard King (rear),Robert Hamilton,John Hamilton,Michael Harvey.
The individual winner was M.Geary of the College but the Bels filled second and third places with Robert Poole and John Hamilton. There were 34 boys in the race - more than half of them being Bels.

With sprinter David Rees, John and Bob Hamilton over the 'half' and 'quarter' and new members Michael and Trevor Day and John Crockford over the longer distances, we have the makings of a first class Youth team.
